name: Default
shortDescription: Open-source authentication and authorization server with OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, social logins, MFA, a hosted login page and an admin dashboard, backed by PostgreSQL.

alerts.message: Open /dashboard and sign in with the value of the ADMIN_SECRET environment variable. Your apps use CLIENT_ID as the client ID; set ALLOWED_ORIGINS to their comma-separated origins before going to production.

Email verification, password reset emails, magic links and social logins are off until you add the matching flags (for example --smtp-host, --smtp-port, --smtp-sender-email or --google-client-id) to the authorizer command in docker-compose.yml.
